basic.name: Healing Beam (Q)
basic.description: Heal target allied Hero or Minion for 172 Health per second as long as they are in range.
basic.developerCommentary: The removal of the energy cost necessitated a nerf.

basic.name: Medivac Dropship (W)
basic.description: Target a location for a Medivac transport. The first allied hero that enters will make the Medivac take off. Lasts 3 seconds on ground.
basic.developerCommentary: The Medivac is one of the few tools that gives Morales agency. It allows for rapid transport of players between map areas. By converting this ultimate-level skill into a basic ability, some adjustments are necessary for balance and practicality.

basic.name: Displacement Grenade (E)
basic.description: Fire a grenade that can be manually detonated, dealing 208 to nearby enemies and knocking them away.

heroic.name: Combat Stimpack (R)
heroic.description:
{highlight}Activate to grant the current Healing Beam target a 50% increase in attack speed and a 10% movement speed bonus for 6 seconds. {/highlight}

{highlight}Redirecting the healing beam leaves the previous target with 0.5 seconds of the effect{/highlight}
heroic.developerCommentary: As previously mentioned, I want to bring Morales closer to the gameplay experience of the Medic in TF2. Introducing Combat Stimpack as a baseline skill that charges up enhances Morales' engagement in gameplay, focusing on skillful play rather than passive cooldown management. This also distinguishes her from other healers.

trait.name: Caduceus Reactor (T)
trait.description: While channeling Healing Beam, Lt. Morales regenerates 2% of her maximum Health per second.

general.name: Base
general.description: Morales no longer has energy regeneration and starts with 0 energy.
general.developerCommentary: This change is due to modifications in her ultimate ability.

1.name: Caduceus Feedback
1.description: Increases Attack Range by 1.1 and Basic Attacks against Heroes generate {highlight}1{/highlight} Energy.
1.developerCommentary: Balancing the talent for the new ultimate

1.name: Life Support
1.description: {highlight}Morales now receives all movement speed bonuses from the target she's healing.{/highlight}
1.developerCommentary: There's no more need for the energy BUT there's always a need for giving Morales a chance to heal junkrat with the fast mount and also follow the steroids target

1.name: Clear!
1.description: {highlight}Morales now reduces the Displacement Grenade cooldown by 3 seconds when hitting 2 targets.{/highlight}
1.developerCommentary: I rebalanced the quest so we could preserve the Displacement Grenade quest and bring earlier the Displacement Grenade reset

4.name: Cellular Reactor
4.description:
Cooldown: 30s
Consume 30 Energy to heal Lt. Morales for 30% of her maximum Health over 3 seconds. Caduceus Reactor is disabled while this is active.
passives: {highlight}Prevents Morales from losing Energy upon death.{/highlight}
4.developerCommentary: Rebalanced it for the new energy settings

4.name: Trauma Trigger
4.description: Taking damage while below 40% Health grants 40 Armor for 3 seconds. This effect has a 30 second cooldown.
passives: Increase the healing provided by Caduceus Reactor from 2% to 4% of Lt. Morales's maximum Health per second.

4.name: Blast Shield
4.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Displacement Grenade are Slowed by 50% for 1 second after being knocked away and grant Lt. Morales a Shield equal to 6% of her maximum Health. This shield stacks up to 5 times.

7.name: EMP Grenade
7.description: Displacement Grenade deals an additional 96 damage over 2 seconds, and up to 400 bonus damage to Shields.
7.developerCommentary: The Displacement Grenade talent tier was not very strong, and the new talents created for Medivac are somewhat stronger, so I'm shifting them to level 7 for better power spikes.

7.name: System Shock
7.description: Heroes hit by Displacement Grenade deal 30% less damage for 3 seconds.
7.developerCommentary: The Displacement Grenade talent tier was not very strong, and the new talents created for Medivac are somewhat stronger, so I'm shifting them to level 7 for better power spikes.

7.name: Bedside Manner
7.description: Heroes hit by Displacement Grenade will take an additional 6% of their maximum Health as damage from Lt. Morales's next Basic Attack against them.
passives: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal an additional 1% of their maximum Health as damage.
7.developerCommentary: The Displacement Grenade talent tier was not very strong, and the new talents created for Medivac are somewhat stronger, so I'm shifting them to level 7 for better power spikes.

10.name: Koprulu Warfare Booster
10.description: {highlight}Steroids charge now makes allied heroes' basic attacks deal an extra 30% damage.{/highlight}
10.developerCommentary: I didn't want to just buff attack speed and movement speed as a simple buff and wanted to make something that reminds me of the Kritzkrieg from TF2. Perfect time to make Morales a significant problem considering that some characters are troublesome with higher attack damage.

10.name: Terran Übercharge Stimulant
10.description: {highlight}Increase Steroids charge movement speed bonus by 25% and makes the target unkillable.{/highlight}
10.developerCommentary: The risk plays with Morales, remember that the Healing Beam can be cancelled with crowd control.

10.name: Battlefield Resuscitation System
10.description: {highlight}Targets receive additional healing equal to 330% of the Healing Beam.{/highlight}
10.developerCommentary: I wanted to give it 300% of the original Healing Beam value.

13.name: Mass Evacuation Protocol
13.description: {highlight}Medivac now takes off 5 seconds after being used and can carry any amount of people. Unloaded heroes will be mounted and can't be dismounted for 1.5 seconds{/highlight}
13.developerCommentary: It's supposed to work like before for any nostalgic player.

13.name: Warp-Speed Rescue
13.description: {highlight}Now Medivac calls upon Morales after 1 second of channeling, the Medivac is 150% faster and has the cooldown reduced by half plus instantly takes off as soon as it's used.{/highlight}
13.developerCommentary: This works very close to how the old Medivac was, but only Morales will ride it.

13.name: Reinforcements
13.description: {highlight}Call down a Medivac Dropship at your Hall of Storms for your allies. After 10 seconds, or when a hero enters, the Medivac will travel to the target location to unload the passenger.{/highlight}
13.developerCommentary: I had to make the talent as NEW because it was a extended part of the Medivac. Changed it to hold only one person and also drop it where Morales wants for increased map control potential.

16.name: Extended Care
16.description: Channeling Healing Beam on a Hero for at least 3 seconds causes them to be healed for 258 over 3 seconds when Healing Beam ends.
passives: Increase the range of Healing Beam by 30%.

16.name: First Responder
16.description: {highlight}Morales can overheal targets, granting them an overshield up to 20% of their maximum health that rapidly decays after 5 seconds. Healing resets the shield duration.{/highlight}
16.developerCommentary: Inspired by the Tf2 medic overheal and bringing some more utility for late game Morales

16.name: Healing Shockwave
16.description: {highlight}Morales' Displacement Grenade now gets bigger the farther it travels, up to 40% extra. On explosion, it also heals allied heroes in the area by 480.{/highlight}
16.developerCommentary: Sometimes using the Displacement Grenade feels like an disadvantage and this is a talent option for this games.

20.name: Safe Zone
20.description: After exiting the Medivac, allies are Protected from all damage for 3 seconds.
passives: Reduce the cooldown of Medivac Dropship abilities by 15 seconds.

20.name: Focus Morales!
20.description: {highlight}When Morales dies, every allied heroes nearby will receive the overcharge effects for 4 seconds.{/highlight}
20.developerCommentary: Now the people on ranked will think twice before saying that

20.name: Medi-Relay Beacon
20.description: {highlight}Morales drops a beacon with 1200 health for 12 seconds. If Morales redirects her healing beam to the beacon, all allied heroes within 6.5 range of that beacon will receive the Healing Beam and overcharge effects used by Morales.{/highlight}
20.developerCommentary: I always saw an opportunity to make Morales area healing a thing and with the Combat Stimpack changes it gets even better

20.name: Unstoppable Rescuer
20.description: {highlight}Activate to increase Morales' movement speed by 125% and grant her unstoppable for 4 seconds.{/highlight}
20.developerCommentary: This is made to be the ultimate safe talento for Morales..i wanted to go more on a Soraka from Lol passive route but i taught this would be funnier and better.

developerCommentary: I believe Morales is either the top or at least among the top three most boring characters to play right now, according to a significant portion of the community. After considering these opinions, I agree with the players: Morales feels more like a tool for the team rather than a hero. You lack agency, and your role is reduced to a walking bot that simply presses Q on someone. The changes I propose are inspired by what I consider the ideal <vanilla, abilities, basic, 0> character, the TF2 Medic. I aim to give Morales a similar level of agency and introduce some risks.
